answeredQuestions.initiative-name-and-description: AI agent providing whole-of-wealth customer profile insight, member movement analytics, FUM retention analysis, and next-best interaction recommendations for an Australian superannuation provider.
answeredQuestions.business-problem: Understand member behavior, identify attrition drivers, diagnose Funds Under Management (FUM) outflows, and deliver trend analysis to guide future customer interactions.
answeredQuestions.intended-member-outcome: Provide tailored analysis and recommendations based on a member's current appetite and wealth profile.
answeredQuestions.advice-boundary: Limit outputs to analysis, factual information, and general guidance; personalized financial advice is out of scope.
answeredQuestions.data-scope: Initial scope uses internal superannuation data only; external financial data sources are excluded.
answeredQuestions.business-success-outcomes: Improve member retention, make staff interactions more effective, and enable proactive outreach.
answeredQuestions.primary-retention-measure: Track whether members showing early disengagement signals later exit or roll over less often.
answeredQuestions.early-disengagement-signals: Reduced or stopped contributions, declining digital engagement, and a closure inquiry.
answeredQuestions.closure-inquiry-trigger: A closure inquiry alone should surface a timely outreach opportunity for staff; no additional disengagement signal is required.
answeredQuestions.contribution-signal-rule: A contribution reduction is assessed relative to the individual member's usual contribution pattern.
answeredQuestions.contribution-threshold-calibration: Use historical fund data to calibrate the contribution reduction threshold and observation window, then validate them with the retention team.
answeredQuestions.digital-engagement-signal-rule: Compare each member's digital activity with their usual pattern and use historical fund data to calibrate the decline threshold and observation window.
answeredQuestions.retention-comparison-approach: Compare members who received proactive outreach with similar flagged members who did not; interpret results as an association, not proof of causation.
answeredQuestions.outreach-outcome-data-availability: Internal systems reliably identify members who received staff outreach and whether they later exited or rolled over.
answeredQuestions.comparison-cohort-availability: Internal data can reliably identify similar flagged members who did not receive staff outreach.
answeredQuestions.retention-outcome-window: Measure exit or rollover outcomes during the six months following outreach, using the same six-month window from the matched comparison group's index date.
answeredQuestions.retention-target-approach: Use a fixed relative reduction target for the six-month exit or rollover rate, validated against historical data.
answeredQuestions.retention-target-percent: Provisional target: 5% relative reduction in exit or rollover rate versus the matched comparison group; validate feasibility against historical data before approval.

nextActions: Choose a historical lookback period to validate the provisional 5% target

userPreferences.question-style: one question per turn with options and a recommendation
